newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daikyo shares tumble on gloomy forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Daikyo shares tumble on gloomy forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Daikyo Inc tumbled on Monday morning, discouraged by the firm's downward revision on late Friday of its earnings forecasts for the 1996/97 business year, brokers said.
At 0148 GMT, the share price was down 30 yen at 395 yen, after having been quoted ask-only at the opening. Volume was 465,000.
Daikyo, a leading condiminium builder, said on Friday that it expected the firm's net parent profit for fiscal 1996/97 to be 500 million yen, down from its earlier forecast of 2.5 billion yen.

Shares in Daikyo were cheered on Friday by newspaper reports that it would appoint a new president from a non-bank financial unit of Sanwa Bank Ltd. Daikyo announced the appointment and the revision of its forecast after the market closed on Friday.
